report_title: December Holiday Packages: Far East First, Winter Sun Watch

destinations.label: Phuket, Thailand (Andaman beaches, 30-32C and dry in December)
destinations.flight_hours_source: Virgin Atlantic LHR-HKT seasonal nonstop from 2026-10-18, scheduled 12h10 (flightconnections.com/flights-from-lhr-to-hkt, checked 2026-09-28)
destinations.nonstop_source: Virgin Atlantic's LHR-HKT service is SEASONAL and starts 18 Oct 2026 (flightconnections.com/flights-from-lhr-to-hkt, checked 2026-09-28). No source in this repository or in the 2026-10-04 research gives its season END, so the 17-23 Dec 2026 departures cannot be confirmed nonstop. UNKNOWN, and unknown is priced economy (owner rule 2026-10-04: business only for a direct flight).

destinations.label: Krabi & Ao Nang, Thailand (limestone-coast beaches, 31-32C and dry in December)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No London nonstop. Fastest standard 1-stop via BKK: LHR-BKK nonstop ~11h45 + connection + BKK-KBV ~1h20, about 14h30 (estimate from published schedules, not live-checked)
destinations.nonstop_source: No London nonstop exists to KBV; every London-Krabi itinerary connects (1 stop via Bangkok). No nonstop listed on Google Flights for LHR 20 Dec 2026 (read 2026-09-29), so not nonstop.

destinations.label: Phu Quoc, Vietnam (island beaches, 30-31C, dry season from December)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No London nonstop. Fastest standard 1-stop via BKK or SGN: London leg ~11h45-12h45 + connection + ~1h-1h30, about 15h (estimate from published schedules, not live-checked)
destinations.nonstop_source: No London nonstop exists to PQC; every London-Phu Quoc itinerary connects (via Bangkok or Ho Chi Minh City). No nonstop listed on Google Flights for LHR 20 Dec 2026 (read 2026-09-29), so not nonstop.

destinations.label: Zanzibar, Tanzania (Nungwi beach; hot, 31-32°C in December)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No London nonstop. Fastest 1-stop on Google Flights for LHR 20 Dec 2026 (read 2026-09-29): Ethiopian via ADD, 11h40; EgyptAir via CAI 12h20. For 20 Jul 2027: Ethiopian via ADD 11h55
destinations.nonstop_source: No London nonstop exists to ZNZ; the fastest listed journey is Ethiopian via Addis Ababa, 1 stop (Google Flights LHR 20 Dec 2026, read 2026-09-29). Not nonstop.

destinations.label: Mauritius (west-coast beaches; summer, 31°C in December)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No nonstop listed on Google Flights for LHR 20 Dec 2026 (read 2026-09-29). Fastest 1-stop: Air France + Air Mauritius via CDG, 14h25; Emirates via DXB, 15h10
destinations.nonstop_source: Google Flights lists NO nonstop for LHR-MRU (read 2026-09-29); the fastest listed journey is Air France + Air Mauritius via CDG, 14h25. Not nonstop.

destinations.label: Cancún & Riviera Maya, Mexico (Caribbean; dry season, 29°C in December)
destinations.flight_hours_source: Virgin Atlantic / Delta LHR-CUN nonstop, 11h01, listed on Google Flights for 20 Dec 2026 (read 2026-09-29)
destinations.nonstop_source: Virgin Atlantic operates LHR-CUN nonstop, 11h01, 18 Oct 2026 - 11 Apr 2027 (read from Virgin Atlantic's own Mexico page and listed on Google Flights for 20 Dec 2026, read 2026-09-29; restated in the 2026-10-04 Mexico/Japan research). December 2026 sits inside that season, so these departures ARE nonstop.

destinations.label: Onna Village, Okinawa, Japan (watch: mainland Japan is about 17°C in December; this beach is 21-26°C)
destinations.flight_hours_source: No London nonstop (read 2026-10-04). LHR-HND on ANA, JAL or BA, then a 2h40 domestic hop to Naha; fastest listed itinerary 16h30
destinations.nonstop_source: No London nonstop exists to OKA: London to Tokyo (HND/NRT) then a 2h40 domestic hop to Naha. Read 2026-10-04. Not nonstop, in either season.
